_rules: Each 'help' is shown in the game's header line: at most 2 lines, each at most 44 characters, lines separated by \n. Each 'label' is a menu row name: at most 22 characters. Each 'word' is a short value or dialog text: at most 24 characters. Use only characters listed in the language's glyph file.
category.display.help:
Change the screen mode, the resolution and
the shape of the picture.
category.graphics.help: Change the quality of the 3D image.
category.audio.help:
Change the volume, the speaker output and
the voice and subtitle languages.
category.controls.help:
Change the controller vibration and the
camera stick settings.
category.savedata.help: Load Game Data and change the save settings.
category.system.help:
Restore the default settings and see the
build information.
display.mode.label: Display mode
display.mode.help:
Play in a window or fullscreen. A change
must be confirmed within 15 seconds.
display.resolution.label: Screen resolution
display.resolution.help:
The window's size, or the monitor's mode
in exclusive fullscreen.
display.aspect.label: Screen ratio
display.aspect.help:
The shape of the picture. Auto fills the
screen, a fixed ratio may add black bars.
display.vsync.label: V-Sync
display.vsync.help:
Show each frame in step with the display's
refresh, which prevents tearing.
display.fps_counter.label: FPS counter
display.fps_counter.help:
Show the frame rate in the corner of the
screen.
display.defaults.help:
Return the display settings to their
defaults.
graphics.render_scale.label: Resolution scale
graphics.render_scale.help:
The 3D picture's sharpness: higher is
sharper, lower is faster.
graphics.msaa.label: Anti-aliasing
graphics.msaa.help:
Reduce jagged edges on 3D geometry with
multisample anti-aliasing.
graphics.anisotropy.label: Texture filtering
graphics.anisotropy.help:
Anisotropic filtering keeps textures sharp
on surfaces seen at a steep angle.
graphics.defaults.help:
Return the graphics settings to their
defaults.
audio.master_volume.label: Master volume
audio.master_volume.help: Adjust the overall volume of the game.
audio.speaker.label: Speaker output
audio.voice.label: Voice
audio.voice.help: Change the language the characters speak.
audio.subtitles.label: Text Language
audio.subtitles.help:
Change the language of all the game's text,
subtitles included.
audio.sound_test.label: Sound test
audio.defaults.help:
Return the volume and the speaker output to
their defaults.
controls.vibration.label: Vibration
controls.vibration.help: Turn the controller vibration on or off.
controls.rumble_strength.label: Vibration strength
controls.rumble_strength.help: Adjust how strongly the controller vibrates.
controls.invert_camera_x.label: Invert camera X
controls.invert_camera_x.help:
Reverse the left and right direction of the
camera stick.
controls.invert_camera_y.label: Invert camera Y
controls.invert_camera_y.help:
Reverse the up and down direction of the
camera stick.
controls.defaults.help:
Return the controller settings to their
defaults.
gameplay.load_game.label: Load Game Data
gameplay.load_game.help:
Load Game Data. Your progress and any
changes made will be saved automatically.
gameplay.autosave.label: Autosave
gameplay.autosave.help:
Turn the game's automatic saving on or
off.
gameplay.defaults.help: Return the save settings to their defaults.
system.restore_all.label: Restore all defaults
system.restore_all.help:
Return every setting of this menu to its
default, except the languages.
system.build.label: Build
system.build.help: The build of this PC version.
menu.defaults.label: Restore defaults
menu.confirm.help:
Keep the new display settings? The previous
ones return when the time runs out.
word.confirm.question: Keep these display settings?
audio.music_volume.label: Music volume
audio.music_volume.help: Adjust the volume of the music.
audio.sfx_volume.label: Sound effects volume
audio.sfx_volume.help: Adjust the volume of the sound effects.
audio.voice_volume.label: Voice volume
audio.voice_volume.help: Adjust the volume of the characters' voices.
audio.subtitles_shown.label: Show subtitles
audio.subtitles_shown.help:
Show or hide the subtitles of the spoken
lines.
